limitations: Original synthetic assumptions are not empirical validation or a real lending recommendation.
Annual endpoint cash feasibility does not establish intra-year liquidity or legal cash availability.
The collateral branch stipulates priority, available estate and timing; actual rights and costs require evidence.
Unweighted operating stresses do not estimate the separate physical default weight; the assessment hurdle and omitted extra costs are assumptions.
Cash projections after a negative balance are conditional missing-finance diagnostics, not completed payments or an automatic workout.
Recorded documentary booleans are not document authentication; actual commitment remains outside scope.
Separate peer/coordinator review, dependency acceptance and whole-edition reader/UI checks remain independent gates.
